checks.title: Confirm payment job and owner
checks.instructions: Name the merchant, payment owner, fulfillment owner, customer contact owner if needed, service deadline, and escalation path.

checks.title: Bind exact order and transaction
checks.instructions: Record store, order, case, transaction and parent transaction IDs, presentment currency, amount, gateway, observation time, and affected FulfillmentOrder IDs. Do not join by buyer name or amount alone.

checks.title: Set capture and release rules
checks.instructions: Record merchant policy for authorization, capture, expiry, partial/multiple capture, manual payment, disputes, and when fulfillment can be reviewed for release. Keep unsupported routes outside this Playbook.

checks.title: Bind two ready Crews
checks.instructions: Record existing or reviewed new Payment Operations Investigator and Store Operations Coordinator IDs, selected skills, and setup state.

checks.title: Probe real source access
checks.instructions: Read a scoped OrderTransaction, parent if present, current order financial state, and affected fulfillment state. Check gateway evidence for claims Shopify cannot establish.

checks.title: Validate payment-to-order handoff
checks.instructions: Run the bundled validator. Reject wrong transaction, wrong currency, authorization-only release, unapproved execution, and missing provider receipt.

checks.title: Review the concrete plan
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source field scope, policy rule, artifact paths, exact proposed action, approval owner, cost, and manual route before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run one real case manually
checks.instructions: Use an authorized real or historical case with current records; save run IDs, validator results, owner decision, and observed result or unknown. Fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Record decisions and receipts
checks.instructions: Keep stable case and action IDs, transaction and fulfillment IDs, approval, current capture proof, provider action receipt, later source check, and duplicate prevention state.

checks.title: Choose recurrence
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed authenticated event with deduplication, retries, concurrency, cost, and notification policy. Re-read current transaction state before acting; setup never moves money.
